classification: Provenance / audit note. Changes no scientific result and authorizes nothing. The sealed probe result, its rows, and its reading are untouched.
authorized_by: PI, 2026-09-26: keep the launcher fix and the G8/G9 split, restore the genuine Sep 18 PASS byte-for-byte, and document the restoration so the history is explicit rather than mysterious.

WHAT_HAPPENED.summary: ACTION_INTERFACE_COMMITMENT_MECHANISM_CONTRACT_RESULT.json is the PRE-RUN authorization record: it evidences that the probe's contracts passed BEFORE any seed was spent (Rule 3). A standing contract test re-ran run_contracts() AFTER the probe had completed and overwrote that record with a FAIL, because gate G8 asked whether the sealed result was absent -- a condition that can never hold again once the probe has legitimately run.

timeline.note: the genuine pre-run authorization. Seeds 19600001..19600016 were allocated 15:16:59Z and spent 15:47:24Z, i.e. AFTER this record.
the overwritten record. A test invocation on 2026-09-22 rewrote the file with result_exists=true; it was committed incidentally alongside unrelated work.

WHAT_HAPPENED.discovered: 2026-09-26, while running the full test suite to establish a green baseline before the cross-scale 2v2 port. The failure was initially mistaken for a plain stale-test problem; reading the gate showed it was structurally unsatisfiable post-run.

RESTORATION.nothing_recomputed: The PASS was NOT regenerated, recomputed, or hand-edited. The exact historical bytes that authorized the run were restored from the commit that recorded them.

verification.method: git object identity, which is what determines the committed content
verification.raw_on_disk_byte_note: The working-tree copy carries CRLF line endings because core.autocrlf=true in this clone, exactly as it did when originally checked out. Raw on-disk bytes therefore differ from the LF blob bytes while the git object is identical; the LF-normalized content hashes match.

G8_is_now_mode_aware.PRE_RUN: no result and no lock -- G8 applies and gates; a run may start
G8_is_now_mode_aware.IN_FLIGHT: lock present with no sealed result -- G8 applies and FAILS; a run is live or crashed and a second must not start
G8_is_now_mode_aware.POST_RUN: result sealed -- G8 is marked applicable=false and is reported but excluded from the verdict

CODE_FIX_ACCOMPANYING_THIS_RESTORATION.G9_SEALED_RESULT_PROVENANCE: New POST_RUN gate that verifies what G8's frozen spec text actually promises ('uses a fresh Rule-9 exploratory block and never overwrites prior scale artifacts') directly against the sealed result: seeds fall inside the Rule-9 block registered to this experiment id with the spec's seed class, seed count and arms match the frozen spec, every trace is complete at HORIZON ticks with a trace hash, and no stale run lock remains. Prior-artifact protection remains G0. This is a stronger post-run check than the existence proxy it replaces.
CODE_FIX_ACCOMPANYING_THIS_RESTORATION.launcher_refusal_UNCHANGED: main() still refuses to promote when the result or the run lock exists. Verified after restoration: the launcher now refuses with 'REFUSING: result or run lock already exists' (the correct reason) rather than 'mechanism contracts are not PASS' (the symptom of the clobbered record).
CODE_FIX_ACCOMPANYING_THIS_RESTORATION.clobber_footgun_closed: main() previously rewrote the authorization record on every --contracts invocation, which is the mechanism that destroyed it. Only a PRE_RUN evaluation may write CONTRACT_RESULT now; POST_RUN evaluations write CONTRACT_ATTESTATION.json instead. Verified by sha256: --contracts leaves CONTRACT_RESULT byte-identical.
CODE_FIX_ACCOMPANYING_THIS_RESTORATION.test: tests/test_action_interface_commitment_mechanism_contracts.py writes the attestation file, never the authorization record, and asserts the mode/gate relationship so a future silent retirement of G8 without G9 fails.

VERIFIED_NOT_JUST_GREEN.IN_FLIGHT_still_blocks: simulated a lock with no result -> overall_pass=false
VERIFIED_NOT_JUST_GREEN.PRE_RUN_still_gates: simulated absent result and lock -> G8 applicable=true, pass=true, no G9
VERIFIED_NOT_JUST_GREEN.G9_negative_control: tampering with the sealed result's seed list made G9 fail on seed_count_matches_spec and seeds_are_registered_rule9_block
VERIFIED_NOT_JUST_GREEN.launcher_negative_control: attempted --promote --seeds 19600001-19600016 in both record states; refused in both
